predecessors.name: Dai
predecessors.text: the Kingdom of Changshan: 'central Hebei' (Eighteen Kingdoms table), carved out of the former Kingdom of Zhao

successors.name: Dai
successors.text: the Kingdom of Changshan: 'central Hebei' (Eighteen Kingdoms table), carved out of the former Kingdom of Zhao

ledger.x: 206: Xiang Yu makes Zhang Er King of Changshan.
205: Chen Yu drives out Zhang Er.

wars.name: Chen Yu's seizure of Changshan
wars.outcome: Chen Yu, helped by Qi, defeated Zhang Er and restored Zhao; Zhang Er fled to Liu Bang and returned with Han Xin to destroy Chen Yu and Zhao Xie.

certainty.note: 'Central Hebei' is all the pages say of the kingdom's land.
